tex_content.html:
Given $w > 0$, there are $w^\prime = w^\prime (w) > 0$ and $T^\prime = T^\prime (w) < \infty $ so that taking $r = \overline{\rho }(w)$ (with reference to Lemma 9.2), if $x_0 \in M^+(w,t)$ and $t_0 \ge T^\prime $ then $B(x_0, t_0, r\sqrt{t_0})$ has volume at least $w^\prime r^3 t_0^{\frac32}$ and sectional curvature at least $- \: r^{-2} \: t_0^{-1}$.

Proof

\sketch Apply the thick–thin decomposition and pointed smooth compactness. Hyperbolic rigidity and the approximation estimates give the required stabilization or geometric conclusion. ↗ lem:kl-thick-thin-decomposition-thick-thin-geometry-lemma

□

\label{applies}
Given $w > 0$, there are
$w^\prime = w^\prime(w) > 0$ and $T^\prime = T^\prime(w) < \infty$ so that
taking $r = \overline{\rho}(w)$
(with reference to Lemma \ref{bigenough}),
if $x_0 \in M^+(w,t)$ and $t_0 \ge T^\prime$ then
$B(x_0, t_0, r\sqrt{t_0})$ has volume at least $w^\prime r^3 t_0^{\frac32}$ and
sectional curvature at least $- \: r^{-2} \: t_0^{-1}$.
\end{lemma}
